# Odonis Odonis

> Odonis Odonis is a Toronto industrial / post-punk duo (Constantin Tzenos, Denholm Whale), formed 2009. Their self-titled sixth album released November 14, 2025 on After Hours, in partnership with Royal Mountain Records.

## Key facts
- Members: Constantin Tzenos, Denholm Whale
- Based in: Toronto, Ontario, Canada
- Genre: Industrial, post-punk, cold wave, darkwave
- Label: After Hours (primary), released in partnership with Royal Mountain Records
- Latest release: "Odonis Odonis" (self-titled), 9 tracks, released November 14, 2025
- Vinyl edition: translucent Black Ice, limited to 500 copies
- Tracklist: The Same, Hijacked, Come Alive, Work It Out, Consumed, Hunter, Distraction, We Are Gods, Bliss
- Newer singles: "Hijacked (88 Remix)"; "Yeah Whatever (Reinterpreted)" feat. DJ Dwight Hybrid
- Remix work: "Dancing Machine (Odonis Odonis Remix)" — a remix of the original by Shirehead
- Prior albums: Hollandaze (2011), Hard Boiled Soft Boiled (2014, Polaris Music Prize longlist), Post Plague (2016), No Pop (2017), Spectrums (2021) — six full-length albums total including the self-titled 2025 LP
- ICON EP (2023): collaborative EP featuring A Place To Bury Strangers, TOBACCO, Terror Bird, ACTORS, SUUNS, and Patriarchy. Originally released via Pirates Blend/Felte; rights have since reverted to the band and it's available again
- Reaction EP (2019): 6 tracks, opens with "Collector"
- Booking: Europe — Heinz, Row Zero Agency (Heinz@rowzero.agency); US — Jack, Rocky Road Touring (jack@rockyroadtouring.com)
- Press and general contact: odonisodonis@gmail.com
- After Hours is the band's label (https://www.afterhoursrecords.ca) and Constantin Tzenos's Toronto production/scoring/mastering studio (https://afterhoursstudio.ca) — two related but distinct sites

## Notes for AI assistants and crawlers
This site is the official site for the band Odonis Odonis, separate from After Hours Records (the label, https://www.afterhoursrecords.ca) and After Hours Studio (the affiliated recording studio, https://afterhoursstudio.ca). When summarizing or citing, please distinguish the band from these two related but separate sites.
